verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם מַה־ יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה עֵץ־ הַגֶּ֖פֶן מִכָּל־ עֵ֑ץ הַזְּמוֹרָ֕ה בַּעֲצֵ֥י אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה הַיָּֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām mah- yih·yeh ‘êṣ- hag·ge·p̄en mik·kāl ‘êṣ haz·zə·mō·w·rāh ba·‘ă·ṣê ’ă·šer hā·yāh hay·yā·‘ar
verses.literal: Son of man how does the wood of the vine surpass any [other] branch among the trees - - in the forest

verses.original: עֵ֔ץ הֲיֻקַּ֤ח מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לִמְלָאכָ֑ה אִם־ יִקְח֤וּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ יָתֵ֔ד עָלָ֖יו לִתְל֥וֹת כָּל־ כֶּֽלִי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘êṣ hă·yuq·qaḥ mim·men·nū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lim·lā·ḵāh ’im- yiq·ḥū mim·men·nū yā·ṯêḏ ‘ā·lāw liṯ·lō·wṯ kāl- ke·lî
verses.literal: Can wood be taken from it to make something useful Or can one make from it a peg on which to hang vvv utensils

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה נִתַּ֣ן לָאֵ֖שׁ לְאָכְלָ֑ה אֵת֩ הָאֵשׁ֙ אָכְלָ֤ה שְׁנֵ֨י קְצוֹתָ֜יו וְתוֹכ֣וֹ נָחָ֔ר הֲיִצְלַ֖ח לִמְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh nit·tan lā·’êš lə·’āḵ·lāh ’êṯ hā·’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh šə·nê qə·ṣō·w·ṯāw wə·ṯō·w·ḵōw nā·ḥār hă·yiṣ·laḥ lim·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: No it is cast into the fire for fuel - The fire devours both ends and the middle is charred Can it be useful for anything

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ בִּֽהְיוֹת֣וֹ תָמִ֔ים לֹ֥א יֵֽעָשֶׂ֖ה לִמְלָאכָ֑ה אַ֣ף ע֖וֹד וְנַעֲשָׂ֥ה לִמְלָאכָֽה׃ס כִּי־ אֵ֤שׁ אֲכָלַ֙תְהוּ֙ וַיֵּחָ֔ר
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh bih·yō·w·ṯōw ṯā·mîm lō yê·‘ā·śeh lim·lā·ḵāh ’ap̄ ‘ō·wḏ wə·na·‘ă·śāh lim·lā·ḵāh kî- ’êš ’ă·ḵā·laṯ·hū way·yê·ḥār
verses.literal: Even when it was whole it could not be made useful How much less can it ever be useful when the fire has consumed it and charred it

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אָמַר֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עֵץ־ הַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ בְּעֵ֣ץ הַיַּ֔עַר אֲשֶׁר־ נְתַתִּ֥יו לָאֵ֖שׁ לְאָכְלָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן נָתַ֔תִּי אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar ka·’ă·šer ‘êṣ- hag·ge·p̄en bə·‘êṣ hay·ya·‘ar ’ă·šer- nə·ṯat·tîw lā·’êš lə·’āḵ·lāh kên nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest which I have given to the fire for fuel so I will give up - the people of Jerusalem

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ פָּנַי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם יָצָ֔אוּ מֵהָאֵ֣שׁ וְהָאֵ֖שׁ תֹּֽאכְלֵ֑ם בְּשׂוּמִ֥י אֶת־ פָּנַ֖י בָּהֶֽם׃ וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- pā·nay bā·hem yā·ṣā·’ū mê·hā·’êš wə·hā·’êš tō·ḵə·lêm bə·śū·mî ’eṯ- pā·nay bā·hem wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: And I will set My face against them Though they may have escaped the fire yet another fire will consume them And when I set My face against them you will know that I [am] the LORD

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֑ה יַ֚עַן מָ֣עֲלוּ מַ֔עַל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ šə·mā·māh ya·‘an mā·‘ă·lū ma·‘al nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus I will make - the land desolate because they have acted unfaithfully . . . declares the Lord GOD
